title: Product
description: Canonical product schema v1.2. All platform data (Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, Unicommerce, BigCommerce) gets normalized into this format by the transformer layer.

id.description: Your internal unique product ID. Generated by your system using UUID or nanoid. Never comes from the platform.

sourceId.description: The original ID from the platform. Used to avoid duplicate ingestion and to sync updates.

x-source.unicommerce: itemTypeDTO.skuCode — this is the primary identifier in Unicommerce

source.description: Which platform this product came from. Set by the connector.

storeId.description: Points to the store record in store.schema.json that owns this product.

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit. WooCommerce sku can be empty string — treat as null. Unicommerce skuCode is the primary key.

title.description: Product display name. Always plain text — never HTML.

description.description: Plain text product description. Always strip HTML before storing.

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name. Raw value — use normalizedBrand for comparisons.

x-source.woocommerce: meta_data where key === 'brand' — plugin-dependent, may be null

category.description: Primary human-facing category label. NOT the same as productType. Shopify's productType field maps here.

x-source.shopify: node.productType — NOTE: despite the field name this is a category label not a type

categoryPath.description: Full category breadcrumb path as an array. BigCommerce uses hierarchical category trees. e.g. ['Garden', 'Bath'].

x-source.magento: not available — use path field in category schema instead
x-source.bigcommerce: resolve full path from category tree API using product.categories[]

productType.description: Platform's internal product structure. NOT a category. Shopify and Unicommerce have no equivalent.

x-source.magento: item.type_id — simple, configurable, bundle, virtual, downloadable

categoryIds.description: List of YOUR internal canonical category IDs. Populated AFTER category ingestion pipeline runs. Never raw platform category IDs.

tags.description: Searchable keyword tags. Always an array of plain strings.

x-source.bigcommerce: product.search_keywords — split by comma if string

attributes.description: Extra product attributes (color, size, material etc). Keys are lowercased. Values are strings.

x-source.shopify: node.options[] — use name.toLowerCase() as key, values.join(', ') as value
x-source.magento: ALL custom_attributes not already mapped (skip: description, brand, url_key, category, image, small_image, thumbnail) — attribute_code as key
x-source.woocommerce: product.attributes[] — attribute.name.toLowerCase() as key, attribute.options.join(', ') as value
x-source.unicommerce: itemTypeDTO.color → attributes.color, itemTypeDTO.size → attributes.size, itemTypeDTO.customFieldValues[] → remaining attributes
x-source.bigcommerce: variant.option_values[].option_display_name as key, collect all labels across variants as value array

images.description: Product images. Always an array — empty array if none. Never null.

altText.description: Alt text. Null if not provided.

x-source.magento: media_gallery_entries[] where disabled !== true — prepend storeBaseUrl + /pub/media/catalog/product
x-source.unicommerce: itemTypeDTO.imageUrl — single image, wrap in array

variants.description: Product variants. Every product must have at least one. Simple/single products get one synthetic variant built from base product fields.

variantId.description: Platform's variant ID. For Unicommerce/simple products, use sku as variantId.

title.description: Variant label e.g. 'Size 8 / Black'. Construct from attributes if platform doesn't provide.

price.description: Current selling price. Always a number — parseFloat() Shopify/WooCommerce strings.

compareAtPrice.description: Original price before discount. Null if no discount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. e.g. INR, USD. Never symbols.

inventoryQty.description: Available quantity. For Unicommerce: inventory - blockedInventory.

x-source.magento: simple → one synthetic variant from base product. configurable → configurable_product_links
x-source.woocommerce: simple → one synthetic variant. variable → GET /products/{id}/variations
x-source.unicommerce: one variant per skuCode — merge product + inventory APIs using skuCode as join key. inventoryQty = inventory - blockedInventory

status.description: Normalized product status across all platforms.

weight.description: Product weight. Unit depends on store configuration.

x-source.shopify: not at product level — available per variant

createdAt.description: When the product was created on the source platform.

updatedAt.description: When the product was last modified on the source platform.

lastSyncedAt.description: When YOUR system last synced this product. Always set by the transformer using new Date().toISOString().

cleanedTitle.description: DERIVED. Title with HTML, trademark symbols (®™©), and extra whitespace removed. Used for display and search indexing.

normalizedBrand.description: DERIVED. Brand lowercased and trimmed for cross-platform deduplication. 'NIKE ', 'Nike', 'nike' all → 'nike'.

pricePerUnit.description: DERIVED. Price per unit quantity (per kg, per litre). Only for grocery/commodity products with unit_quantity in attributes. Null otherwise.
